"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export default function AgendarCitaPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [fecha, setFecha] = useState("");
  const [hora, setHora] = useState("");
  const [motivo, setMotivo] = useState("");

  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(false);
  const [mensaje, setMensaje] = useState<{
    tipo: "exito" | "error";
    texto: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const horariosDisponibles = [
    "08:00",
    "09:00",
    "10:00",
    "11:00",
    "12:00",
    "14:00",
    "15:00",
    "16:00",
    "17:00",
    "18:00",
  ];

  const hoy = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

  const solicitarCita = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setCargando(true);
    setMensaje(null);

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (userError || !user)
        throw new Error(
          "No se pudo verificar tu sesión. Intenta iniciar sesión de nuevo.",
        );

      const nuevaCita = {
        fecha: fecha,
        hora: hora,
        motivo: motivo,
        estado: "pendiente",
        paciente_id: user.id,
      };

      const { error: insertError } = await supabase
        .from("citas")
        .insert([nuevaCita]);

      if (insertError) throw insertError;

      setMensaje({
        tipo: "exito",
        texto:
          "¡Tu solicitud de cita ha sido enviada! El especialista la revisará pronto.",
      });

      setFecha("");
      setHora("");
      setMotivo("");

      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push("/dashboard-paciente");
      }, 3000);
    } catch (error) {
      // CORRECCIÓN TYPESCRIPT APLICADA AQUÍ (Sin usar 'any')
      console.error("Error al agendar:", error);
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        setMensaje({ tipo: "error", texto: error.message });
      } else {
        setMensaje({
          tipo: "error",
          texto:
            "Ocurrió un error al agendar la cita. Por favor intenta de nuevo.",
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col items-center py-12 px-4 font-sans">
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl">
        <Link
          href="/dashboard-paciente"
          className="inline-flex items-center text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600 transition mb-6 font-medium"
        >
          <svg
            className="w-5 h-5 mr-2"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth="2"
              d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18"
            ></path>
          </svg>
          Volver a mi panel
        </Link>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
          {/* CORRECCIÓN TAILWIND APLICADA AQUÍ (bg-linear-to-r) */}
          <div className="bg-linear-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-800 p-8 text-white">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Agendar Nueva Cita</h1>
            <p className="text-blue-100">
              Selecciona la fecha y hora que mejor se adapte a ti.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="p-8">
            {mensaje && (
              <div
                className={`p-4 rounded-xl mb-8 font-medium border ${
                  mensaje.tipo === "exito"
                    ? "bg-green-50 text-green-700 border-green-200"
                    : "bg-red-50 text-red-600 border-red-200"
                }`}
              >
                {mensaje.texto}
                {mensaje.tipo === "exito" && (
                  <p className="text-sm mt-1 text-green-600 font-normal">
                    Redirigiendo a tu panel...
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={solicitarCita} className="space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                    Fecha deseada
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    required
                    min={hoy}
                    value={fecha}
                    onChange={(e) => setFecha(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-3.5 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 transition text-gray-700"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                    Hora de atención
                  </label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={hora}
                    onChange={(e) => setHora(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-3.5 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 transition text-gray-700 bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="" disabled>
                      Selecciona una hora...
                    </option>
                    {horariosDisponibles.map((h) => (
                      <option key={h} value={h}>
                        {h}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">
                  Motivo de la consulta (Breve)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  required
                  rows={3}
                  value={motivo}
                  onChange={(e) => setMotivo(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ej. Terapia individual, manejo de estrés, primera consulta..."
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-3.5 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 transition text-gray-700 resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={cargando || mensaje?.tipo === "exito"}
                  className={`w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg transition-all shadow-md ${
                    cargando || mensaje?.tipo === "exito"
                      ? "bg-gray-400 text-white cursor-not-allowed shadow-none"
                      : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                  }`}
                >
                  {cargando
                    ? "Procesando solicitud..."
                    : "Confirmar Solicitud de Cita"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";

// Tipado estricto
interface MessageItem {
  id: string;
  sender: "user" | "assistant";
  text: string;
  quickActions?: string[];
}

export default function AssistantWidget() {
  // Mantenemos isOpen del contexto por si otros botones de la app lo abren/cierran
  const { isOpen, setIsOpen } = useAssistant();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Controlamos los mensajes y la escritura localmente para inyectar el cerebro
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState("");
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<MessageItem[]>([
    {
      id: "1",
      sender: "assistant",
      text: "¡Hola! Soy tu asistente inteligente. ¿En qué te puedo ayudar hoy?",
      quickActions: ["Agendar cita", "Registrar paciente"],
    },
  ]);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) scrollToBottom();
  }, [messages, isOpen, isTyping]);

  // Identificar el rol del usuario según la URL
  let rolUsuario: AppRole | null = null;
  if (pathname.includes("/dashboard-psicologo")) rolUsuario = "psicologo";
  else if (pathname.includes("/dashboard-paciente")) rolUsuario = "paciente";
  else if (pathname.includes("/dashboard-secretaria"))
    rolUsuario = "secretaria";

  const procesarMensaje = async (texto: string) => {
    if (!texto.trim()) return;

    // 1. Mostrar mensaje del usuario
    setMessages((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id: Date.now().toString(), sender: "user", text: texto },
    ]);
    setIsTyping(true);

    const contextoActual: AssistantContext = {
      userRole: rolUsuario,
      currentRoute: pathname,
      isModalOpen: false,
      pageElements: [],
    };

    try {
      // 2. Consultar al Cerebro
      const resolucion = await Promise.resolve(
        assistantBrain.processInput(texto, contextoActual),
      );

      setTimeout(() => {
        const data = resolucion as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
        const accionObj = (data?.action || data?.intent || data) as
          | Record<string, unknown>
          | undefined;

        let tipoAccion = accionObj?.actionType || accionObj?.type;
        const payloadCrudo = accionObj?.payload;

        let payloadFinal =
          typeof payloadCrudo === "function"
            ? (payloadCrudo as (role: AppRole | null) => string)(rolUsuario)
            : payloadCrudo;

        let textoBot =
          typeof resolucion.message === "function"
            ? (resolucion.message as (role: AppRole | null) => string)(
                rolUsuario,
              )
            : (resolucion.message as string);

        // 🟢 INTERCEPTOR GPS: Toma el control total de la acción
        const textoMin = texto.toLowerCase();

        // CORRECCIÓN: Buscamos palabras clave exactas (sustantivos) para evitar cruces con verbos genéricos
        const intencionPaciente =
          payloadFinal === "BOT_NUEVO_PACIENTE" ||
          textoMin.includes("paciente");
        const intencionCita =
          payloadFinal === "OPEN_MODAL_NUEVA_CITA" ||
          textoMin.includes("cita") ||
          textoMin.includes("agendar");
        const intencionEvolucion =
          payloadFinal === "BOT_NUEVA_EVOLUCION" ||
          textoMin.includes("sesión") ||
          textoMin.includes("sesion") ||
          textoMin.includes("evolución");

        // Evaluamos primero la evolución/sesión para que no choque con otras
        if (intencionEvolucion) {
          if (pathname.includes("/historias/")) {
            tipoAccion = "TRIGGER_EVENT";
            payloadFinal = "BOT_NUEVA_EVOLUCION";
            textoBot =
              "Enseguida te abro el formulario para registrar la evolución de esta sesión.";
          } else {
            tipoAccion = "NAVIGATE";
            payloadFinal = "/dashboard-psicologo/historias";
            textoBot =
              "Para registrar una sesión, primero debes seleccionar el expediente del paciente en Historias Clínicas.";
          }
        } else if (intencionPaciente) {
          if (pathname.includes("/pacientes")) {
            tipoAccion = "TRIGGER_EVENT";
            payloadFinal = "BOT_NUEVO_PACIENTE";
            textoBot =
              "Claro, te abro el formulario para registrar un nuevo paciente.";
          } else {
            tipoAccion = "NAVIGATE";
            payloadFinal = "/dashboard-psicologo/pacientes";
            textoBot =
              "Para registrar un paciente, primero te llevaré al Directorio.";
          }
        } else if (intencionCita) {
          if (pathname.includes("/agenda") || pathname.includes("/citas")) {
            tipoAccion = "TRIGGER_EVENT";
            payloadFinal = "OPEN_MODAL_NUEVA_CITA";
            textoBot = "¡Claro que sí! Abriendo el formulario para tu cita.";
          } else {
            tipoAccion = "NAVIGATE";
            payloadFinal =

            textoBot =

          }
        }

        // 3. Responder en el chat
        setMessages((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          {
            id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
            sender: "assistant",
            text: textoBot,
          },
        ]);
        setIsTyping(false);

        console.log(
          `🕵️‍♂️ RADAR WIDGET - Acción: [${tipoAccion}] -> Payload: [${payloadFinal}]`,
        );

        // 4. Ejecutar la magia
        if (
          tipoAccion === "TRIGGER_EVENT" &&
          typeof payloadFinal === "string"
        ) {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(payloadFinal));
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event(payloadFinal));
        } else if (
          tipoAccion === "NAVIGATE" &&
          typeof payloadFinal === "string"
        ) {
          router.push(payloadFinal);
        }
      }, 800); // Simulamos un tiempo de pensamiento para que se vea natural
    } catch (error) {

      setIsTyping(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSend = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const textoGuardado = inputText;
    setInputText("");
    procesarMensaje(textoGuardado);
  };

  const handleQuickAction = (actionText: string) => {
    procesarMensaje(actionText);
  };

  return (

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-16 right-0 w-87.5 md:w-100 h-137.5 max-h-[80vh] bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 origin-bottom-right">

                  Guía de navegación V2

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";

export default function GuardiaRutas({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [estadoSuscripcion, setEstadoSuscripcion] = useState("activa");

  useEffect(() => {
    const verificarRutasYRoles = async () => {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      const rutasPublicas = ["/", "/login", "/registro", "/login-personal"];
      const esRutaPublica = rutasPublicas.includes(pathname);

      if (!session) {
        if (!esRutaPublica) router.push("/login");
        else setCargando(false);
      } else {
        const { data: perfil } = await supabase
          .from("roles_usuarios")
          .select("rol")
          .eq("correo", session.user.email)
          .single();

        const rolUsuario = perfil?.rol || "paciente";

        if (esRutaPublica) {
          if (rolUsuario === "paciente") router.push("/dashboard-paciente");
          else if (rolUsuario === "psicologo")
            router.push("/dashboard-psicologo");
          else if (rolUsuario === "secretaria")
            router.push("/dashboard-secretaria");
        } else {
          if (rolUsuario === "psicologo") {
            const { data: tu } = await supabase
              .from("tenant_users")
              .select("tenant_id, tenants(estado_suscripcion)")
              .eq("usuario_id", session.user.id)
              .single();

            // 🟢 CORRECCIÓN TYPESCRIPT: Eliminamos el 'any' usando un tipo explícito
            type TenantData = { estado_suscripcion?: string };
            const tenantObj = tu?.tenants as TenantData | null | undefined;
            const estadoDB = tenantObj?.estado_suscripcion || "restringido";

            setEstadoSuscripcion(estadoDB);
          }
          setCargando(false);
        }
      }
    };

    verificarRutasYRoles();

    const {
      data: { subscription },
    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(() => {
      verificarRutasYRoles();
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [pathname, router]);

  if (cargando) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const enPaginaSuscripcion = pathname === "/dashboard-psicologo/suscripcion";
  const accesoBloqueado =
    (estadoSuscripcion === "inactiva" || estadoSuscripcion === "restringido") &&
    !enPaginaSuscripcion &&
    pathname.includes("/dashboard-psicologo");

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen">
      <div
        className={`transition-all duration-300 h-full ${accesoBloqueado ? "opacity-40 pointer-events-none blur-sm" : ""}`}
      >
        {children}
      </div>

      {accesoBloqueado && (
        /* 🟢 CORRECCIÓN TAILWIND: z-100 en lugar de z-[100] */
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50/80 backdrop-blur-md p-6">
          <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-lg text-center border border-slate-100 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-4">
              Activa tu cuenta para continuar
            </h2>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mb-8 font-medium">
              Para acceder a tu agenda, pacientes y herramientas, necesitas
              activar tu período de prueba o suscribirte.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard-psicologo/suscripcion")}
              className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black py-4 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-transform transform hover:scale-[1.02]"
            >
              Ver Planes y Activar
            </button>

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

// 1. Definimos la estructura exacta para eliminar el error "Unexpected any"
interface Cita {
  id: string;
  paciente_id: string;
  psicologo_id: string;
  fecha_hora: string;
  motivo: string;
  estado: string;
  notas_previas: string;
}

export default function ResumenClinico({ pacienteId }: { pacienteId: string }) {
  const [citas, setCitas] = useState<Cita[]>([]);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 2. Movemos la función adentro del useEffect para evitar el error de dependencias (exhaustive-deps)
    const cargarCitas = async () => {
      if (!pacienteId) return;

      setCargando(true);

      // 3. Usamos el cliente estándar de Supabase
      const supabase = createClient(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
      );

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("citas")
        .select("*")
        .eq("paciente_id", pacienteId)
        .order("fecha_hora", { ascending: true });

      if (error) {
        console.error("Error al cargar citas:", error);
      } else {
        setCitas((data as Cita[]) || []);
      }
      setCargando(false);
    };

    cargarCitas();
  }, [pacienteId]);

  // Separar citas futuras de las pasadas
  const ahora = new Date();
  const citasProgramadas = citas.filter(
    (c) => new Date(c.fecha_hora) >= ahora && c.estado === "Programada",
  );
  const historialCitas = citas.filter(
    (c) => new Date(c.fecha_hora) < ahora || c.estado !== "Programada",
  );

  if (cargando) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center py-20">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-10 w-10 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
      {/* CABECERA Y BOTÓN AGENDAR */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            Resumen Clínico
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-sm">
            Gestiona las sesiones y el historial del paciente.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30 flex items-center gap-2">
          <svg
            className="w-5 h-5"
            fill="none"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"
            />
          </svg>
          Agendar Cita
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* PRÓXIMA CITA (TARJETA DESTACADA) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 p-6 md:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-2 h-full bg-teal-500"></div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
          <svg
            className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-500"
            fill="none"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
            />
          </svg>
          Próxima Sesión
        </h3>

        {citasProgramadas.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 md:items-center">
            {/* 4. Corregimos la clase de Tailwind sugerida */}
            <div className="bg-teal-50 dark:bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-400 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl text-center min-w-30">
              <div className="text-3xl font-black">
                {new Date(citasProgramadas[0].fecha_hora).getDate()}
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                {new Date(citasProgramadas[0].fecha_hora).toLocaleString(
                  "es-ES",
                  { month: "short" },
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">
                {new Date(citasProgramadas[0].fecha_hora).toLocaleTimeString(
                  "es-ES",
                  { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" },
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                Motivo:{" "}
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-gray-200">
                  {citasProgramadas[0].motivo || "Sesión regular"}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-gray-400 italic">
            No hay citas futuras programadas para este paciente.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* HISTORIAL DE CITAS */}
      <div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-4">
          Historial de Citas
        </h3>
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden">
          {historialCitas.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5">
              {historialCitas.map((cita) => (
                <div
                  key={cita.id}
                  className="p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-4 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      <svg
                        className="w-5 h-5"
                        fill="none"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        stroke="currentColor"
                      >
                        <path
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                          strokeWidth={2}
                          d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                        />
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {new Date(cita.fecha_hora).toLocaleDateString("es-ES", {
                          weekday: "long",
                          year: "numeric",
                          month: "long",
                          day: "numeric",
                        })}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                        {cita.motivo || "Sesión de seguimiento"}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span
                      className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                        cita.estado === "Completada"
                          ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
                          : cita.estado === "Cancelada"
                            ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-400"
                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-gray-300"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {cita.estado}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              El historial clínico está vacío.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";

export default function ComunidadPremiumLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  // 🟢 ESTADO PARA MANEJAR LA SESIÓN INTELIGENTE
  const [usuarioLogueado, setUsuarioLogueado] = useState<{
    iniciales: string;
    rutaPanel: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Efecto sutil de sombra al hacer scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // 🟢 VERIFICADOR DE SESIÓN AL CARGAR LA COMUNIDAD
  useEffect(() => {
    const verificarSesion = async () => {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

      if (session?.user?.email) {
        const email = session.user.email;
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from("roles_usuarios")
          .select("rol")
          .eq("correo", email)
          .maybeSingle();

        let ruta = "/dashboard-paciente"; // Default
        if (data?.rol === "psicologo") ruta = "/dashboard-psicologo";
        if (data?.rol === "secretaria") ruta = "/dashboard-secretaria";

        setUsuarioLogueado({
          iniciales: email.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
          rutaPanel: ruta,
        });
      }
    };
    verificarSesion();
  }, []);

  const navLinks = [
    { name: "Explorar", path: "/comunidad" },
    { name: "Artículos", path: "/comunidad/articulos" },
    { name: "Eventos", path: "/comunidad/talleres" },
    { name: "Recursos", path: "/comunidad/biblioteca" },
    { name: "Directorio", path: "/comunidad/profesionales" },
    { name: "Grupos", path: "/comunidad/grupos" },
    { name: "Convocatorias", path: "/comunidad/convocatorias" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] font-sans flex flex-col text-slate-900 selection:bg-indigo-100 selection:text-indigo-900">
      <header
        className={`sticky top-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300 ${
          scrolled
            ? "bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]"
            : "bg-white border-b border-slate-100"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-20">
            {/* Logo y Branding */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-6 lg:gap-8 shrink-0">
              <Link
                href="/comunidad"
                className="flex items-center gap-2.5 group shrink-0"
              >
                <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg shadow-sm group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300">
                  Ψ
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="font-black text-xl leading-none text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                    Clinesfera
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-widest leading-none mt-1">
                    Ecosistema
                  </span>
                </div>
              </Link>

              {/* Menú Escritorio (Con scroll horizontal si es necesario) */}
              <nav className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-1 ml-4 overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar">
                {navLinks.map((link) => {
                  const isActive =
                    pathname === link.path ||
                    (link.path !== "/comunidad" &&
                      pathname.startsWith(link.path));
                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={link.name}
                      href={link.path}
                      className={`px-3 xl:px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs xl:text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-300 whitespace-nowrap ${
                        isActive
                          ? "bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-md"
                          : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {link.name}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </nav>
            </div>

            {/* Acciones de Usuario (Escritorio) */}
            <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-3 xl:gap-5 shrink-0">
              <button className="text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-indigo-50">
                <svg
                  className="w-5 h-5"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>

              {/* LA CAMPANITA LLEVA AL CENTRO DE NOTIFICACIONES */}
              {usuarioLogueado && (
                <Link
                  href="/comunidad/notificaciones"
                  className="relative text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-indigo-50"
                  title="Ver mi actividad y alertas"
                >
                  <svg
                    className="w-5 h-5"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-rose-500 rounded-full border-2 border-white animate-pulse"></span>
                </Link>
              )}

              <div className="w-px h-6 bg-slate-200"></div>

              {/* 🟢 BOTÓN DE REGRESO AL INICIO (ESCRITORIO) */}
              <Link
                href="/"
                className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 font-bold text-xs xl:text-sm transition-colors"
                title="Volver al Portal Principal"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2.5}
                    d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6"
                  />
                </svg>
                Inicio
              </Link>

              {/* BOTÓN DINÁMICO DE SESIÓN Y CERTIFICADOS */}
              {usuarioLogueado ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <Link
                    href="/comunidad/certificados"
                    className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-600 font-bold text-xs xl:text-sm transition-colors"
                  >
                    <svg
                      className="w-4 h-4"
                      fill="none"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2.5}
                        d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.965 11.965 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                    Mis Certificados
                  </Link>
                  <Link
                    href={usuarioLogueado.rutaPanel}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50 text-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs xl:text-sm font-bold transition-all shadow-sm group whitespace-nowrap"
                  >
                    <div className="w-6 h-6 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black group-hover:bg-indigo-600 group-hover:text-white transition-colors uppercase shrink-0">
                      {usuarioLogueado.iniciales}
                    </div>
                    <span>Mi Panel</span>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <Link
                  href="/login?returnTo=/comunidad"
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs xl:text-sm font-bold transition-all shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Iniciar Sesión
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Menú Hamburguesa (Móvil) */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
              className="lg:hidden p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 focus:outline-none"
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                {mobileMenuOpen ? (
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"
                  />
                )}
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 📱 DESPLEGABLE MENÚ MÓVIL */}
        {mobileMenuOpen && (
          <div className="lg:hidden bg-white border-t border-slate-100 absolute w-full shadow-2xl animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-200">
            <nav className="px-4 pt-2 pb-6 space-y-1">
              {navLinks.map((link) => (
                <Link
                  key={link.name}
                  href={link.path}
                  onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                  className={`block px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-base font-bold transition-colors ${
                    pathname === link.path
                      ? "bg-slate-900 text-white"
                      : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900"
                  }`}
                >
                  {link.name}
                </Link>
              ))}

              <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-100">
                {/* 🟢 BOTONES MÓVILES (Notificaciones, Certificados y Panel) */}
                {usuarioLogueado ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <Link
                        href="/comunidad/notificaciones"
                        onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                        className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
                      >
                        <svg
                          className="w-5 h-5"
                          fill="none"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2.5}
                            d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9"
                          />
                        </svg>
                        Alertas
                      </Link>
                      <Link
                        href="/comunidad/certificados"
                        onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                        className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold"
                      >
                        <svg
                          className="w-5 h-5"
                          fill="none"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2.5}
                            d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.965 11.965 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"
                          />
                        </svg>
                        Diplomas
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                    <Link
                      href={usuarioLogueado.rutaPanel}
                      onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-center justify-center w-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold mt-2"
                    >
                      Volver a mi Panel Clínico
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Link
                    href="/login?returnTo=/comunidad"
                    onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center w-full bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-sm"
                  >
                    Iniciar Sesión
                  </Link>
                )}

                {/* 🟢 BOTÓN DE REGRESO AL INICIO (MÓVIL) */}
                <Link
                  href="/"
                  onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold mt-2 transition-colors"
                >
                  <svg
                    className="w-5 h-5"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2.5}
                      d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  Volver al Inicio Principal
                </Link>
              </div>
            </nav>
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 md:py-12">
        {children}
      </main>

      <footer className="bg-white border-t border-slate-200 py-12 mt-auto">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 opacity-80">
            <div className="w-6 h-6 bg-slate-300 text-white rounded-md flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
              Ψ
            </div>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-500 text-sm">
              Clinesfera Ecosistema © 2026
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-6 text-sm font-bold text-slate-400">
            <Link href="#" className="hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors">
              Privacidad Clínica
            </Link>
            <Link href="#" className="hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors">
              Términos de Uso
            </Link>
            <Link href="#" className="hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors">
              Normas de la Comunidad
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";

interface Taller {
  id: string;
  titulo: string;
  fecha_hora: string;
  modalidad: string;
  precio: number;
}

interface PostComunidad {
  id: string;
  titulo: string;
  contenido: string;
  creado_el: string;
  perfil_psicologo: { nombre_completo: string } | null;
}

interface RawPost {
  id: string;
  titulo: string;
  contenido: string;
  creado_el: string;
}

// 🟢 BARO NGA INTERFACE: Para iti Artikulo a naggapu iti DB
interface Articulo {
  id: string;
  titulo: string;
  autor: string;
  categoria: string;
  tiempo_lectura: string;
  imagen_color: string;
  creado_el: string;
}

export default function ComunidadExplorarPage() {
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [modalAbierto, setModalAbierto] = useState(false);
  const [publicando, setPublicando] = useState(false);

  const [eventos, setEventos] = useState<Taller[]>([]);
  const [conversaciones, setConversaciones] = useState<PostComunidad[]>([]);

  // 🟢 KINIKKAT TI HARDCODED STATE: Ita ket maysa a nadalus nga awan linaonna nga array
  const [articulos, setArticulos] = useState<Articulo[]>([]);

  const [nuevoDebate, setNuevoDebate] = useState({
    pregunta: "",
    tag: "Debate Clínico",
  });

  const cargarDatos = useCallback(async () => {
    setCargando(true);
    try {
      // 1. Kargaen dagiti Artikulo
      const { data: dataArticulos } = await supabase
        .from("articulos_comunidad")
        .select("*")
        .order("creado_el", { ascending: false })
        .limit(2);

      if (dataArticulos) setArticulos(dataArticulos);

      // 2. Kargaen dagiti Pasken
      const { data: dataEventos } = await supabase
        .from("talleres")
        .select("id, titulo, fecha_hora, modalidad, precio")
        .eq("estado", "activo")
        .order("fecha_hora", { ascending: true })
        .limit(3);

      if (dataEventos) setEventos(dataEventos);

      // 3. Kargaen dagiti Post iti Komunidad
      const { data: dataPosts } = await supabase
        .from("comunidad_posts")
        .select("id, titulo, contenido, creado_el")
        .eq("estado", "publicado")
        .order("creado_el", { ascending: false });

      if (dataPosts) {
        const postsFormateados = dataPosts.map((p: RawPost) => ({
          ...p,
          perfil_psicologo: { nombre_completo: "Miembro de la Comunidad" },
        }));
        setConversaciones(postsFormateados as PostComunidad[]);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error cargando comunidad:", error);
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const iniciar = async () => {
      await cargarDatos();
    };
    iniciar();
  }, [cargarDatos]);

  const handlePublicarDebate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setPublicando(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

      if (!session) {
        alert("Debes iniciar sesión para publicar en la comunidad.");
        return;
      }

      const { data: tu } = await supabase
        .from("tenant_users")
        .select("tenant_id")
        .eq("usuario_id", session.user.id)
        .single();

      if (!tu) {
        alert("Solo los profesionales pueden abrir debates actualmente.");
        return;
      }

      const { error } = await supabase.from("comunidad_posts").insert({
        tenant_id: tu.tenant_id,
        psicologo_id: session.user.id,
        titulo: nuevoDebate.tag,
        contenido: nuevoDebate.pregunta,
        estado: "publicado",
      });

      if (error) throw error;

      setModalAbierto(false);
      setNuevoDebate({ pregunta: "", tag: "Debate Clínico" });
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error al publicar:", error);
      alert("Hubo un error al publicar tu debate.");
    } finally {
      setPublicando(false);
    }
  };

  if (cargando)
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <div className="w-full animate-in fade-in duration-700 slide-in-from-bottom-4 space-y-16 pb-12">
      <section className="relative bg-slate-900 rounded-4xl p-10 md:p-16 lg:p-20 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-10">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-linear-to-br from-indigo-500/30 to-purple-600/30 rounded-full blur-[80px] -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3"></div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-80 h-80 bg-teal-500/20 rounded-full blur-[60px] translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2"></div>

        <div className="relative z-10 max-w-2xl">
          <span className="inline-block px-4 py-1.5 bg-white/10 text-indigo-200 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest rounded-full backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 mb-6">
            Ecosistema Profesional
          </span>
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black text-white leading-[1.1] mb-6 tracking-tight">
            Conecta. Aprende. <br />
            <span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-400 to-teal-300">
              Comparte conocimiento.
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-300 text-lg md:text-xl font-medium mb-10 max-w-xl leading-relaxed">
            Una comunidad diseñada para profesionales, estudiantes y mentes
            curiosas interesadas en comprender mejor el comportamiento humano y
            el bienestar.
          </p>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            <Link
              href="/comunidad/articulos"
              className="bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 font-black px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-xl transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 text-center"
            >
              Explorar Artículos
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/comunidad/grupos"
              className="bg-purple-600/20 hover:bg-purple-600/40 text-purple-100 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <svg
                className="w-5 h-5"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              Grupos
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/comunidad/convocatorias"
              className="bg-teal-600/20 hover:bg-teal-600/40 text-teal-100 border border-teal-500/30 font-bold px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <svg
                className="w-5 h-5"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M21 13.255A23.931 23.931 0 0112 15c-3.183 0-6.22-.62-9-1.745M16 6V4a2 2 0 00-2-2h-4a2 2 0 00-2 2v2m4 6h.01M5 20h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"
                />
              </svg>
              Convocatorias
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 🟢 SECCIÓN DE LECTURAS (Dinamikoon a naggapu iti DB) */}
      <section>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-2">
              Lecturas Recomendadas
            </h2>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              Artículos clínicos y divulgativos tendencia.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {articulos.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-10 bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-100">
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              Nuevos artículos próximamente.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {articulos.map((art) => (
              <div
                key={art.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-slate-200/50 transition-all duration-300 group flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-6 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-full sm:w-40 h-48 sm:h-auto rounded-2xl ${art.imagen_color || "bg-slate-100"} shrink-0`}
                ></div>
                <div className="flex flex-col flex-1 py-1">
                  <span className="text-xs font-black text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    {art.categoria}
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-3 leading-snug group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">
                    {art.titulo}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-50">
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      {art.autor.charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {art.autor}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">
                        {new Date(art.creado_el).toLocaleDateString("es-ES", {
                          month: "short",
                          day: "numeric",
                        })}{" "}
                        · {art.tiempo_lectura}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        <section className="lg:col-span-1 bg-slate-50 rounded-4xl p-8 border border-slate-100 h-fit">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">
              Próximos Eventos
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {eventos.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm font-bold text-center py-10">
                No hay eventos programados.
              </p>
            ) : (
              eventos.map((evento) => (
                <div
                  key={evento.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-slate-100 hover:border-indigo-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
                    <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md">
                      {new Date(evento.fecha_hora).toLocaleDateString("es-ES", {
                        day: "numeric",
                        month: "short",
                      })}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md ${Number(evento.precio) === 0 ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"}`}
                    >
                      {Number(evento.precio) === 0
                        ? "Gratuito"
                        : `$${evento.precio}`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 leading-tight mb-2 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">
                    {evento.titulo}
                  </h3>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>{" "}
                    {evento.modalidad}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="lg:col-span-2">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-1">
                Muro Comunitario
              </h2>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium text-sm">
                Debates, networking y preguntas abiertas.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setModalAbierto(true)}
              className="text-sm font-bold bg-slate-900 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-600 transition-colors shadow-md shrink-0"
            >
              Crear Debate
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {conversaciones.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-20 bg-slate-50 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-200">
                <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
                  Sé el primero en iniciar un debate en la comunidad.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              conversaciones.map((conv) => (
                <div
                  key={conv.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black text-indigo-600 shadow-inner">
                      {conv.perfil_psicologo?.nombre_completo?.charAt(0) || "U"}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                        {conv.perfil_psicologo?.nombre_completo || "Usuario"}
                      </h4>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                        {conv.titulo}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-slate-800 font-medium text-lg leading-relaxed mb-6 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    {conv.contenido}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-6 border-t border-slate-50 pt-4">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                      {new Date(conv.creado_el).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      {modalAbierto && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-4xl w-full max-w-xl flex flex-col shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">
                  Crear Debate
                </h2>
                <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
                  Comparte con profesionales y estudiantes.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalAbierto(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors bg-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-sm"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-5 h-5"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
            <form
              onSubmit={handlePublicarDebate}
              className="p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6"
            >
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Categoría
                </label>
                <select
                  value={nuevoDebate.tag}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNuevoDebate({ ...nuevoDebate, tag: e.target.value })
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none text-slate-700 font-medium text-sm"
                >
                  <option value="Debate Clínico">🧠 Debate Clínico</option>
                  <option value="Estudiantes">🎓 Estudiantes</option>
                  <option value="Networking">🤝 Networking</option>
                  <option value="Investigación">🔬 Investigación</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <textarea
                  required
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder="Escribe tu pregunta o idea..."
                  value={nuevoDebate.pregunta}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNuevoDebate({ ...nuevoDebate, pregunta: e.target.value })
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none text-slate-700 font-medium text-sm resize-none"
                ></textarea>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end pt-2">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={publicando || !nuevoDebate.pregunta.trim()}
                  className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center min-w-32"
                >
                  {publicando ? (
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                  ) : (
                    "Publicar"
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
