"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Documento {
  id: number;
  titulo: string;
  tipo: string;
  tamaño: string;
  acceso: string;
  descripcion: string;
}

// 🟢 TIPO ESTRICTO PARA EVITAR EL USO DE 'any'
type FiltroFavorito = "todos" | "articulos" | "eventos" | "debates";

export default function BibliotecaComunidadPage() {
  const [pestanaActiva, setPestanaActiva] = useState<"favoritos" | "recursos">(
    "favoritos",
  );

  // 🟢 ESTADOS DE LA PESTAÑA: FAVORITOS
  const [filtroFavoritos, setFiltroFavoritos] =
    useState<FiltroFavorito>("todos");
  const opcionesFiltros: FiltroFavorito[] = [
    "todos",
    "articulos",
    "eventos",
    "debates",
  ];

  const [favoritos, setFavoritos] = useState([
    {
      id: "fav-1",
      tipo: "articulos",
      etiqueta: "Artículo",
      titulo: "El impacto del uso excesivo de pantallas en el neurodesarrollo",
      autor: "Mgtr. Carlos Ruiz",
      fecha: "Hace 5 días",
      color: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700",
    },
    {
      id: "fav-2",
      tipo: "eventos",
      etiqueta: "Evento",
      titulo: "Simposio Internacional: Salud Mental Universitaria",
      autor: "Clinesfera Eventos",
      fecha: "25 Octubre 2026",
      color: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700",
    },
    {
      id: "fav-3",
      tipo: "debates",
      etiqueta: "Debate",
      titulo: "Experiencias realizando la primera entrevista clínica",
      autor: "Ana Torres",
      fecha: "Hace 5 horas",
      color: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700",
    },
  ]);

  // 🟢 ESTADOS DE LA PESTAÑA: RECURSOS (Conectado a Supabase)
  const [rolUsuario, setRolUsuario] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [documentos, setDocumentos] = useState<Documento[]>([]);
  const [filtroRecursos, setFiltroRecursos] = useState("Todos");
  const filtrosDocs = ["Todos", "PDF", "DOCX", "XLSX", "Media"];

  // 1. CARGA DE BASE DE DATOS PARA RECURSOS
  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarDatos = async () => {
      try {
        const {
          data: { user },
        } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (user && user.email) {
          const { data: rolData } = await supabase
            .from("roles_usuarios")
            .select("rol")
            .eq("correo", user.email)
            .maybeSingle();

          if (rolData) setRolUsuario(rolData.rol);
        }

        const { data: datosBD, error } = await supabase
          .from("documentos")
          .select("*")
          .order("id", { ascending: true });

        if (error) console.error("Error consultando documentos:", error);
        if (datosBD) setDocumentos(datosBD);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error al cargar la base de datos:", error);
      } finally {
        setCargando(false);
      }
    };

    cargarDatos();
  }, []);

  // 2. LÓGICA DE PERMISOS
  const tieneAcceso = (nivelAcceso: string) => {
    if (nivelAcceso === "publico") return true;
    if (
      nivelAcceso === "restringido" &&
      (rolUsuario === "psicologo" || rolUsuario === "secretaria")
    )
      return true;
    return false;
  };

  // 3. FILTROS Y ACCIONES
  const favoritosFiltrados = favoritos.filter(
    (fav) => filtroFavoritos === "todos" || fav.tipo === filtroFavoritos,
  );
  const documentosFiltrados =
    filtroRecursos === "Todos"
      ? documentos
      : documentos.filter((doc) =>
          doc.tipo.toUpperCase().includes(filtroRecursos),
        );

  const eliminarFavorito = (id: string) => {
    setFavoritos(favoritos.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full animate-in fade-in duration-700 slide-in-from-bottom-4 space-y-12">
      {/* ==========================================
          1. HERO SECTION PREMIUM
          ========================================== */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-4xl p-10 md:p-14 text-white relative overflow-hidden shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-8">
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-full blur-[80px] -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/3"></div>

        <div className="relative z-10 max-w-2xl">
          <Link
            href="/comunidad"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-300 font-bold text-sm hover:text-white transition-colors mb-4 bg-white/5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10"
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">&larr;</span> Volver al Explorador
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-black mb-4 tracking-tight leading-tight">
            Biblioteca Clínica
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-300 text-lg font-medium">
            Tu colección personal de conocimiento. Gestiona tus artículos
            guardados, eventos próximos y descarga recursos para tu práctica
            profesional.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* CONTROLES DE PESTAÑAS PRINCIPALES */}
        <div className="relative z-10 bg-white/10 p-1.5 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 flex flex-col sm:flex-row w-full md:w-auto shrink-0 gap-1 sm:gap-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => setPestanaActiva("favoritos")}
            className={`flex-1 sm:flex-none px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
              pestanaActiva === "favoritos"
                ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-md"
                : "text-white hover:bg-white/10"
            }`}
          >
            Mis Guardados
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setPestanaActiva("recursos")}
            className={`flex-1 sm:flex-none px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
              pestanaActiva === "recursos"
                ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-md"
                : "text-white hover:bg-white/10"
            }`}
          >
            Recursos Oficiales
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ==========================================
          2. PESTAÑA: MIS GUARDADOS (Favoritos)
          ========================================== */}
      {pestanaActiva === "favoritos" && (
        <div className="space-y-8 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500">
          <div className="flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2 pb-2">
            {opcionesFiltros.map((filtro) => (
              <button
                key={filtro}
                onClick={() => setFiltroFavoritos(filtro)}
                className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold capitalize transition-colors whitespace-nowrap border ${
                  filtroFavoritos === filtro
                    ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 shadow-sm"
                    : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                }`}
              >
                {filtro}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {favoritosFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-4xl p-16 text-center border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-4xl mb-4">📌</div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                No hay elementos guardados
              </h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium max-w-sm mx-auto">
                Explora la comunidad y utiliza el botón &quot;Guardar&quot; para
                construir tu biblioteca personal.
              </p>
              <Link
                href="/comunidad"
                className="inline-block mt-6 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors"
              >
                Explorar Comunidad
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {favoritosFiltrados.map((item) => (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group"
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
                    <span
                      className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${item.color}`}
                    >
                      {item.etiqueta}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => eliminarFavorito(item.id)}
                      className="text-indigo-600 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors p-1"
                      title="Quitar de guardados"
                    >
                      <svg
                        className="w-5 h-5"
                        fill="currentColor"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        stroke="currentColor"
                      >
                        <path
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                          strokeWidth={2}
                          d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z"
                        />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3 leading-snug group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">
                    {item.titulo}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="mt-auto pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
                    <span>{item.autor}</span>
                    <span>{item.fecha}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==========================================
          3. PESTAÑA: RECURSOS (Conectado a BD)
          ========================================== */}
      {pestanaActiva === "recursos" && (
        <div className="space-y-6 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 mb-2">
            <div className="flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto pb-2 sm:pb-0">
              {filtrosDocs.map((f) => (
                <button
                  key={f}
                  onClick={() => setFiltroRecursos(f)}
                  className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-300 border ${
                    filtroRecursos === f
                      ? "bg-teal-600 text-white border-teal-600 shadow-md"
                      : "bg-white text-slate-500 border-slate-200 hover:border-teal-200 hover:bg-teal-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  {f}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {!cargando && rolUsuario === "psicologo" && (
              <button className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold py-2.5 px-5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth="2.5"
                    d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12"
                  ></path>
                </svg>
                Subir Documento
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {cargando ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 bg-white rounded-4xl border border-slate-100">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-teal-100 border-t-teal-600 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4"></div>
              <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold text-sm tracking-widest uppercase animate-pulse">
                Desencriptando biblioteca segura...
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : documentosFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-4xl p-16 text-center border border-slate-100 shadow-sm mt-6">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-50 text-slate-300 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
                <svg
                  className="w-10 h-10"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                No se encontraron documentos
              </h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
                No hay recursos disponibles para el filtro &quot;
                {filtroRecursos}&quot;.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {documentosFiltrados.map((doc) => {
                const permitido = tieneAcceso(doc.acceso);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={doc.id}
                    className={`relative bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start gap-5 ${
                      permitido
                        ? "border-slate-100 hover:border-teal-200 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-teal-900/5 hover:-translate-y-1 group"
                        : "border-slate-100 opacity-90 bg-slate-50/50"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div
                      className={`w-16 h-16 shrink-0 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-black shadow-sm ${
                        doc.tipo.includes("PDF")
                          ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600"
                          : doc.tipo.includes("DOC")
                            ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600"
                            : doc.tipo.includes("XLS")
                              ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600"
                              : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                      } ${!permitido && "grayscale opacity-60"}`}
                    >
                      {doc.tipo}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 w-full flex flex-col h-full">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2 gap-2">
                        <h3
                          className={`font-black text-lg leading-tight truncate ${permitido ? "text-slate-900 group-hover:text-teal-600 transition-colors" : "text-slate-500"}`}
                        >
                          {doc.titulo}
                        </h3>

                        {doc.acceso === "restringido" && (
                          <span className="shrink-0 bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-1 rounded-md flex items-center gap-1 border border-slate-200">
                            <svg
                              className="w-3 h-3"
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            >
                              <path
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                strokeWidth="2"
                                d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8V7z"
                              ></path>
                            </svg>
                            Uso Clínico
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mb-5 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                        {doc.descripcion}
                      </p>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-auto pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 rounded-md">
                          {doc.tamaño}
                        </span>

                        {permitido ? (
                          <button className="text-teal-700 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-teal-50 hover:bg-teal-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors text-sm shadow-sm">
                            <svg
                              className="w-4 h-4"
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            >
                              <path
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                strokeWidth="2.5"
                                d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-4l-4 4m0 0l-4-4m4 4V4"
                              ></path>
                            </svg>
                            Descargar
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            disabled
                            className="text-slate-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl cursor-not-allowed text-sm"
                          >
                            <svg
                              className="w-4 h-4"
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                            >
                              <path
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                strokeWidth="2.5"
                                d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8V7z"
                              ></path>
                            </svg>
                            Bloqueado
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {!permitido && (
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-[1px] rounded-3xl z-10 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        <span className="bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-full shadow-xl">
                          Requiere verificación profesional
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";

interface CertificadoDB {
  id: string;
  titulo_evento: string;
  emisor: string;
  horas: number;
  codigo_verificacion: string;
  estado: "Emitido" | "En Curso";
  url_pdf: string;
}

export default function CertificadosPage() {
  const [certificados, setCertificados] = useState<CertificadoDB[]>([]);
  const [certificadoActivo, setCertificadoActivo] =
    useState<CertificadoDB | null>(null);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);

  // 🟢 CORRECCIÓN APLICADA: Toda la lógica asíncrona ahora vive de forma segura dentro del useEffect
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true; // Control de seguridad anti-fugas de memoria

    const fetchCertificados = async () => {
      try {
        // 1. Identificar al usuario activo
        const {
          data: { session },
        } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

        if (!session?.user?.email) {
          if (isMounted) setCargando(false);
          return;
        }

        // 2. Buscar su ID en la tabla principal
        const { data: usuario } = await supabase
          .from("roles_usuarios")
          .select("id")
          .eq("correo", session.user.email)
          .single();

        if (usuario) {
          // 3. Traer solo los certificados de este usuario
          const { data: certs, error } = await supabase
            .from("certificados")
            .select("*")
            .eq("usuario_id", usuario.id);

          if (!error && certs && isMounted) {
            setCertificados(certs);
            // Auto-seleccionar el primero si está emitido
            const primerEmitido = certs.find((c) => c.estado === "Emitido");
            if (primerEmitido) setCertificadoActivo(primerEmitido);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error cargando certificados:", error);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setCargando(false);
      }
    };

    fetchCertificados();

    // Limpieza cuando el usuario sale de la página
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full animate-in fade-in duration-700 slide-in-from-bottom-4 pb-12">
      {/* 1. CABECERA */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-10">
        <div>
          <Link
            href="/comunidad"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-600 font-bold text-sm hover:text-indigo-800 transition-colors mb-4 bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100"
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">&larr;</span> Volver al Explorador
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2 tracking-tight">
            Mis Certificados
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium text-lg max-w-2xl">
            Gestiona, visualiza y descarga los avales académicos de los eventos
            y talleres en los que has participado.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
        {/* 2. LISTADO DE CERTIFICADOS (Sidebar Izquierdo) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 px-1">
            Historial Académico
          </h2>

          {cargando ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-10">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-indigo-100 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
            </div>
          ) : certificados.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl p-6 text-center">
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium text-sm">
                Aún no tienes certificados registrados en la plataforma.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            certificados.map((cert) => (
              <button
                key={cert.id}
                onClick={() =>
                  cert.estado === "Emitido" && setCertificadoActivo(cert)
                }
                disabled={cert.estado === "En Curso"}
                className={`w-full text-left p-5 rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden ${
                  certificadoActivo?.id === cert.id
                    ? "bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-600 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-200 text-white"
                    : cert.estado === "En Curso"
                      ? "bg-slate-50 border-slate-100 opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-md text-slate-900"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                  <span
                    className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1 rounded-md ${
                      certificadoActivo?.id === cert.id
                        ? "bg-white/20 text-white"
                        : cert.estado === "En Curso"
                          ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"
                          : "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cert.estado}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <h3
                  className={`font-bold leading-tight mb-1 ${certificadoActivo?.id === cert.id ? "text-white" : "text-slate-900"}`}
                >
                  {cert.titulo_evento}
                </h3>
                <p
                  className={`text-xs font-medium line-clamp-1 ${certificadoActivo?.id === cert.id ? "text-indigo-200" : "text-slate-500"}`}
                >
                  {cert.emisor}
                </p>
              </button>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 3. VISOR DEL DIPLOMA (Panel Derecho) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8">
          {certificadoActivo ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-4xl p-6 md:p-8 border border-slate-200 shadow-xl shadow-slate-200/50 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6 relative z-10">
                <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                  <svg
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.965 11.965 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  ID: {certificadoActivo.codigo_verificacion}
                </span>
                <a
                  href={certificadoActivo.url_pdf || "#"}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  <svg
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2.5}
                      d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-4l-4 4m0 0l-4-4m4 4V4"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  Descargar PDF
                </a>
              </div>

              <div className="w-full aspect-[1.414/1] bg-linear-to-br from-indigo-900 via-slate-900 to-indigo-900 rounded-2xl p-2 md:p-4 shadow-2xl relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-10 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-white via-transparent to-transparent"></div>
                <div className="w-full h-full border border-white/20 rounded-xl p-6 md:p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center relative bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xs">
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-white/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white/80 font-serif text-3xl mb-6 border border-white/20">
                    Ψ
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-white/80 uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-xs md:text-sm font-bold mb-8">
                    Certificado Oficial
                  </h3>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-4xl font-black text-white mb-6 tracking-tight font-serif">
                    {certificadoActivo.titulo_evento}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-white/70 text-sm md:text-base max-w-lg mb-8 leading-relaxed font-medium">
                    Acreditación válida por{" "}
                    <strong className="text-white">
                      {certificadoActivo.horas} horas académicas
                    </strong>
                    .
                  </p>
                  <div className="mt-auto w-full flex justify-between items-end border-t border-white/10 pt-6">
                    <div className="text-left">
                      <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm">
                        {certificadoActivo.emisor}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="h-full bg-slate-50 rounded-4xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center min-h-125">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm mb-4 text-slate-300">
                <svg
                  className="w-10 h-10"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                Sin Certificados
              </h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
                No se encontraron certificados emitidos en tu historial.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  Briefcase,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  ArrowRight,
  Search,
  Building,
  GraduationCap,
  CheckCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

interface Convocatoria {
  id: string;
  tipo: "empleo" | "alianzas" | "academico";
  titulo: string;
  entidad: string;
  ubicacion: string;
  descripcion: string;
  etiquetas: string[];
  creado_el: string;
  activa: boolean;
}

export default function ConvocatoriasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [filtro, setFiltro] = useState<
    "todas" | "empleo" | "alianzas" | "academico"
  >("todas");

  const [convocatorias, setConvocatorias] = useState<Convocatoria[]>([]);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);

  // Estados para el Modal de Postulación
  const [modalAbierto, setModalAbierto] = useState(false);
  const [convocatoriaSeleccionada, setConvocatoriaSeleccionada] =
    useState<Convocatoria | null>(null);
  const [procesandoPostulacion, setProcesandoPostulacion] = useState(false);
  const [postulacionExitosa, setPostulacionExitosa] = useState(false);

  const cargarConvocatorias = useCallback(async () => {
    setCargando(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("convocatorias")
        .select("*")
        .eq("activa", true)
        .order("creado_el", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      setConvocatorias(data as Convocatoria[]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error cargando convocatorias:", error);
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // 🟢 CORRECCIÓN 1: Envolvemos en función interna asíncrona
  useEffect(() => {
    const inicializar = async () => {
      await cargarConvocatorias();
    };
    inicializar();
  }, [cargarConvocatorias]);

  const abrirModalPostulacion = async (convocatoria: Convocatoria) => {
    const {
      data: { session },
    } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

    if (!session) {
      alert("Debes iniciar sesión para poder postular a una vacante.");
      router.push("/login?returnTo=/comunidad/convocatorias");
      return;
    }

    setConvocatoriaSeleccionada(convocatoria);
    setPostulacionExitosa(false);
    setModalAbierto(true);
  };

  const confirmarPostulacion = async () => {
    if (!convocatoriaSeleccionada) return;
    setProcesandoPostulacion(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

      if (!session) throw new Error("Sin sesión activa");

      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("convocatorias_postulaciones")
        .insert({
          convocatoria_id: convocatoriaSeleccionada.id,
          usuario_id: session.user.id,
          estado: "enviada",
        });

      if (error) {
        if (error.code === "23505") {
          throw new Error(
            "Ya has postulado anteriormente a esta convocatoria.",
          );
        }
        throw error;
      }

      setPostulacionExitosa(true);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const msj =
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Error al procesar la postulación.";
      alert(msj);
      setModalAbierto(false);
    } finally {
      setProcesandoPostulacion(false);
    }
  };

  const filtradas = convocatorias.filter(
    (c) => filtro === "todas" || c.tipo === filtro,
  );

  return (
    <div className="animate-in fade-in duration-700 relative">
      {/* Cabecera */}
      <div className="mb-10">
        <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-4">
          Bolsa de Oportunidades
        </h1>
        <p className="text-lg text-slate-500 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
          Encuentra tu próximo desafío profesional. Explora vacantes clínicas,
          alianzas para compartir consultorio y oportunidades de investigación.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Barra de Filtros */}
      <div className="bg-white p-2 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 mb-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-2">
        <div className="relative flex-1 flex items-center">
          <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400 absolute left-4" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Buscar vacantes o especialidades..."
            className="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 text-slate-700 outline-none"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full md:w-px md:h-12 bg-slate-200 shrink-0"></div>
        <div className="flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-1 p-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => setFiltro("todas")}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${filtro === "todas" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"}`}
          >
            Todas
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFiltro("empleo")}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 ${filtro === "empleo" ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"}`}
          >
            <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4" /> Empleo
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFiltro("alianzas")}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 ${filtro === "alianzas" ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"}`}
          >
            <Building className="w-4 h-4" /> Alianzas
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFiltro("academico")}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 ${filtro === "academico" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"}`}
          >
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" /> Académico
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Lista de Convocatorias */}
      {cargando ? (
        <div className="py-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4"></div>
          <p className="font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-xs">
            Cargando Oportunidades...
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filtradas.map((convocatoria) => (
            <div
              key={convocatoria.id}
              className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 rounded-3xl hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 items-start"
            >
              <div
                className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                  convocatoria.tipo === "empleo"
                    ? "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600"
                    : convocatoria.tipo === "alianzas"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600"
                      : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600"
                }`}
              >
                {convocatoria.tipo === "empleo" && (
                  <Briefcase className="w-7 h-7" />
                )}
                {convocatoria.tipo === "alianzas" && (
                  <Building className="w-7 h-7" />
                )}
                {convocatoria.tipo === "academico" && (
                  <GraduationCap className="w-7 h-7" />
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between md:items-start gap-2 mb-2">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">
                      {convocatoria.titulo}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-slate-600 font-bold mt-1">
                      {convocatoria.entidad}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg w-fit shrink-0">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{" "}
                    {new Date(convocatoria.creado_el).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 mb-4">
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />{" "}
                  {convocatoria.ubicacion}
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-600 mb-5 leading-relaxed">
                  {convocatoria.descripcion}
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {convocatoria.etiquetas.map((etiqueta, idx) => (
                    <span
                      key={idx}
                      className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg"
                    >
                      {etiqueta}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="w-full md:w-auto mt-4 md:mt-0 flex flex-col justify-center h-full pt-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => abrirModalPostulacion(convocatoria)}
                  className="w-full md:w-auto bg-slate-900 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group-hover:shadow-md"
                >
                  Postular{" "}
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}

          {filtradas.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-20 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl">
              <Search className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-4" />
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">
                No hay convocatorias
              </h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500">
                Intenta con otro filtro o categoría.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL DE POSTULACIÓN */}
      {modalAbierto && convocatoriaSeleccionada && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
            {postulacionExitosa ? (
              <div className="p-10 text-center flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-10 h-10" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                  ¡Postulación Enviada!
                </h3>
                <p className="text-slate-500 mb-8 font-medium">
                  Hemos notificado a{" "}
                  <strong>{convocatoriaSeleccionada.entidad}</strong>. Si tu
                  perfil se ajusta, se pondrán en contacto contigo vía correo
                  electrónico.
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setModalAbierto(false)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                >
                  Entendido, volver a la bolsa

                    >

  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);

  const [pestanaActiva, setPestanaActiva] = useState("guardados");

  const pestanas = [
    { id: "guardados", label: "Artículos Guardados" },
    { id: "eventos", label: "Mis Eventos y Talleres" },
    { id: "documentos", label: "Mis Descargas" },
  ];

  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarDatos = async () => {
      try {
        const {
          data: { user },
        } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (user) {
          setEmailUsuario(user.email || "Usuario Clínico");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error cargando perfil:", error);
      } finally {
        setCargando(false);
      }

    cargarDatos();

  return (
    <div className="w-full animate-in fade-in duration-700 slide-in-from-bottom-4">
      {/* 1. CABECERA DEL PERFIL */}

                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar por nombre, enfoque, trastorno o ciudad..."
              value={busqueda}
              onChange={(e) => setBusqueda(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-4 bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded-2xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400 focus:bg-white/20 transition-all font-medium text-white placeholder-slate-400 shadow-inner backdrop-blur-sm"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. BARRA DE FILTROS */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-10">
        <div className="flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2 pb-2 md:pb-0 border-b border-transparent md:border-b-0">
          {especialidades.map((esp) => (
            <button
              key={esp}
              onClick={() => setFiltroEspecialidad(esp)}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-300 ${
                filtroEspecialidad === esp
                  ? "bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-md"
                  : "bg-white text-slate-500 border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50"
              }`}
            >
              {esp}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="text-slate-500 font-bold text-sm shrink-0">
          {profesionalesFiltrados.length} perfiles encontrados
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 3. ESTADO DE CARGA */}
      {cargando ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-indigo-100 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4"></div>
          <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold text-sm tracking-widest uppercase animate-pulse">
            Cargando perfiles...
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* 4. CUADRÍCULA DE PERFILES */
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {profesionalesFiltrados.map((prof) => (
            <div
              key={prof.id}
              className="bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-indigo-900/10 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col group"
            >
              {/* Banner Superior del Perfil */}
              <div
                className={`h-24 w-full bg-linear-to-r ${prof.color} relative`}
              >
                {/* Botón Flotante de Conexiones */}
                <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-3 py-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-sm">
                  <svg
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2.5}
                      d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  {prof.conexiones}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="px-6 pb-6 flex-1 flex flex-col relative">
                {/* Avatar Circular Solapado */}
                <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-black text-slate-400 shadow-md absolute -top-10 left-6">
                  {prof.nombre.charAt(0)}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-12 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                    <h3 className="font-black text-xl text-slate-900 leading-tight group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">
                      {prof.nombre}
                    </h3>
                    {prof.verificado && (
                      <div
                        className="text-emerald-500"
                        title="Profesional Verificado por Clinesfera"
                      >
                        <svg
                          className="w-5 h-5"
                          fill="currentColor"
                          viewBox="0 0 20 20"
                        >
                          <path
                            fillRule="evenodd"
                            d="M6.267 3.455a3.066 3.066 0 001.745-.723 3.066 3.066 0 013.976 0 3.066 3.066 0 001.745.723 3.066 3.066 0 012.812 2.812c.051.643.304 1.254.723 1.745a3.066 3.066 0 010 3.976 3.066 3.066 0 00-.723 1.745 3.066 3.066 0 01-2.812 2.812 3.066 3.066 0 00-1.745.723 3.066 3.066 0 01-3.976 0 3.066 3.066 0 00-1.745-.723 3.066 3.066 0 01-2.812-2.812 3.066 3.066 0 00-.723-1.745 3.066 3.066 0 010-3.976 3.066 3.066 0 00.723-1.745 3.066 3.066 0 012.812-2.812zm7.44 5.252a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z"
                            clipRule="evenodd"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                    {prof.especialidad}
                  </p>

                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm line-clamp-3 mb-5 leading-relaxed">
                    {prof.bio}
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 mb-6">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
                      <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <svg
                          className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400"
                          fill="none"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      {prof.enfoque}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
                      <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <svg
                          className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400"
                          fill="none"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M17.657 16.657L13.414 20.9a1.998 1.998 0 01-2.827 0l-4.244-4.243a8 8 0 1111.314 0z"
                          />
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M15 11a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      {prof.ciudad}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
                      <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <svg
                          className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400"
                          fill="none"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      {prof.modalidad}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 🟢 CORRECCIÓN APLICADA: Ahora es un Link de Next.js */}
                <div className="mt-auto pt-5 border-t border-slate-100 flex gap-2">
                  <Link
                    href={`/comunidad/profesionales/${prof.id}`}
                    className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 text-center font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors text-sm"
                  >
                    Ver Perfil
                  </Link>
                  {prof.verificado && (
                    <button className="flex-1 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-indigo-700 hover:text-white font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors text-sm shadow-sm">
                      Agendar Cita
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ESTADO VACÍO */}
      {!cargando && profesionalesFiltrados.length === 0 && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-4xl p-16 text-center border border-slate-100 shadow-sm max-w-2xl mx-auto mt-10">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-50 text-slate-300 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
            <svg
              className="w-10 h-10"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={1.5}
                d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
            No se encontraron especialistas
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
            Prueba buscando con otros términos o seleccionando otra
            especialidad.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setBusqueda("");
              setFiltroEspecialidad("Todos");
            }}
            className="mt-6 text-indigo-600 font-bold bg-indigo-50 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors"
          >
            Limpiar filtros
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

export default function PublicarArticuloPage() {
  const [guardando, setGuardando] = useState(false);
  const [etiquetaInput, setEtiquetaInput] = useState("");

  const [articulo, setArticulo] = useState({
    titulo: "",
    subtitulo: "",
    contenido: "",
    categoria: "",
    tipo: "Divulgativo", // Académico o Divulgativo
    etiquetas: [] as string[],
    referencias: "",
  });

  const categorias = [
    "Psicología Clínica",
    "Neuropsicología",
    "Psicoterapia",
    "Evaluación Psicológica",
    "Salud Mental",
    "Psicología Infantil",
    "Desarrollo Humano",
    "Investigación",
  ];

  const handleAgregarEtiqueta = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && etiquetaInput.trim() !== "") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!articulo.etiquetas.includes(etiquetaInput.trim())) {
        setArticulo({
          ...articulo,
          etiquetas: [...articulo.etiquetas, etiquetaInput.trim()],
        });
      }
      setEtiquetaInput("");
    }
  };

  const handleEliminarEtiqueta = (tagEliminar: string) => {
    setArticulo({
      ...articulo,
      etiquetas: articulo.etiquetas.filter((tag) => tag !== tagEliminar),
    });
  };

  const handlePublicar = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGuardando(true);
    // Simulación de guardado
    setTimeout(() => {
      setGuardando(false);
      alert("¡Artículo publicado exitosamente en la comunidad!");
    }, 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-8 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
      {/* NAVEGACIÓN SUPERIOR */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <Link
          href="/comunidad/articulos"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 font-bold text-sm hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors"
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">&larr;</span> Volver a Biblioteca
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button className="px-5 py-2.5 font-bold text-slate-500 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors shadow-sm text-sm">
            Guardar Borrador
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handlePublicar}
            disabled={guardando || !articulo.titulo || !articulo.contenido}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 font-bold text-white bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 text-sm flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            {guardando ? (
              <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
            ) : (
              "Publicar Artículo"
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* COLUMNA IZQUIERDA: EDITOR PRINCIPAL */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Zona de Portada */}
          <div className="w-full h-64 bg-slate-50 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-4xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:border-indigo-300 transition-all cursor-pointer group">
            <svg
              className="w-10 h-10 mb-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={1.5}
                d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
              />
            </svg>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-500 group-hover:text-indigo-500">
              Subir imagen de portada
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium mt-1">
              PNG, JPG (Recomendado 1200x600px)
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-4xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            {/* Títulos */}
            <div>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Título del artículo..."
                value={articulo.titulo}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setArticulo({ ...articulo, titulo: e.target.value })
                }
                className="w-full text-3xl md:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-200 border-none focus:ring-0 px-0 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Subtítulo o breve descripción (opcional)..."
                value={articulo.subtitulo}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setArticulo({ ...articulo, subtitulo: e.target.value })
                }
                className="w-full text-lg md:text-xl font-medium text-slate-500 placeholder:text-slate-300 border-none focus:ring-0 px-0 outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <hr className="border-slate-100 my-4" />

            {/* Barra de herramientas simulada */}
            <div className="flex gap-2 p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-100">
              {["B", "I", "U"].map((format) => (
                <button
                  key={format}
                  className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-sm transition-all"
                >
                  {format}
                </button>
              ))}
              <div className="w-px h-6 bg-slate-200 my-auto mx-2"></div>
              <button className="px-3 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-bold text-slate-600 text-xs hover:bg-white hover:shadow-sm transition-all gap-1.5">
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M13.828 10.172a4 4 0 00-5.656 0l-4 4a4 4 0 105.656 5.656l1.102-1.101m-.758-4.899a4 4 0 005.656 0l4-4a4 4 0 00-5.656-5.656l-1.1 1.1"
                  />
                </svg>{" "}
                Enlace
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Contenido (Textarea) */}
            <div>
              <textarea
                placeholder="Escribe tu conocimiento aquí..."
                rows={15}
                value={articulo.contenido}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setArticulo({ ...articulo, contenido: e.target.value })
                }
                className="w-full text-lg text-slate-700 font-medium leading-relaxed placeholder:text-slate-200 border-none focus:ring-0 px-0 outline-none resize-none"
              ></textarea>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* COLUMNA DERECHA: METADATOS Y CONFIGURACIÓN */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Tarjeta: Tipo de Contenido (Punto 35) */}
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="font-black text-slate-900 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <svg
                className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"
                />
              </svg>
              Tipo de Publicación
            </h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-slate-50 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  setArticulo({ ...articulo, tipo: "Divulgativo" })
                }
                className={`py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition-all ${articulo.tipo === "Divulgativo" ? "bg-white text-emerald-600 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"}`}
              >
                Divulgativo
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setArticulo({ ...articulo, tipo: "Académico" })}
                className={`py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition-all ${articulo.tipo === "Académico" ? "bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"}`}
              >
                Académico
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 mt-3 leading-relaxed">
              {articulo.tipo === "Divulgativo"
                ? "Dirigido al público general. Usa lenguaje accesible para explicar conceptos psicológicos."
                : "Dirigido a estudiantes e investigadores. Requiere rigor metodológico y citas APA."}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Tarjeta: Categoría y Etiquetas */}
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                Categoría
              </label>
              <select
                value={articulo.categoria}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setArticulo({ ...articulo, categoria: e.target.value })
                }
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700"
              >
                <option value="">Selecciona una categoría...</option>
                {categorias.map((cat) => (
                  <option key={cat} value={cat}>
                    {cat}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                Etiquetas
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={etiquetaInput}
                onChange={(e) => setEtiquetaInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleAgregarEtiqueta}
                placeholder="Escribe y presiona Enter..."
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-3"
              />
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {articulo.etiquetas.map((tag) => (
                  <span
                    key={tag}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
                  >
                    {tag}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleEliminarEtiqueta(tag)}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500"
                    >
                      &times;
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tarjeta: Referencias */}
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="font-black text-slate-900 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <svg
                className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253"
                />
              </svg>
              Referencias Bibliográficas
            </h3>
            <textarea
              rows={4}
              value={articulo.referencias}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setArticulo({ ...articulo, referencias: e.target.value })
              }

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
// IMPORTACIONES DEL ASISTENTE INTELIGENTE CORREGIDAS
import { AssistantProvider } from "../../lib/assistant/ChatContext";
import AssistantWidget from "../components/AssistantWidget";

export default function PacienteLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [autorizado, setAutorizado] = useState(false);
  const [menuAbierto, setMenuAbierto] = useState(false);

  // ESTADOS DE LA MARCA BLANCA
  const [nombreClinica, setNombreClinica] = useState("Clinesfera");
  const [colorPrimario, setColorPrimario] = useState("#4F46E5"); // Indigo-600 por defecto

  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarMarcaBlanca = async (userId: string) => {
      try {
        const { data: relacion } = await supabase
          .from("relaciones_clinicas")
          .select("psicologo_id")
          .eq("paciente_id", userId)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (relacion?.psicologo_id) {
          const { data: config } = await supabase
            .from("configuracion_clinica")
            .select("nombre_clinica, color_primario")
            .eq("psicologo_id", relacion.psicologo_id)
            .maybeSingle();

          if (config) {
            if (config.nombre_clinica) setNombreClinica(config.nombre_clinica);
            if (config.color_primario) setColorPrimario(config.color_primario);

            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
              "--color-marca",
              config.color_primario || "#4F46E5",
            );
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error cargando marca blanca:", error);
      }
    };

    const validarCandado = async () => {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }
      setAutorizado(true);
      cargarMarcaBlanca(session.user.id);
    };

    validarCandado();
  }, [router]);

  const handleCerrarSesion = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.push("/");
  };

  if (!autorizado) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div
          className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4"
          style={{ borderTopColor: "var(--color-marca, #4F46E5)" }}
        ></div>
        <p
          className="font-bold tracking-widest text-sm animate-pulse"
          style={{ color: "var(--color-marca, #4F46E5)" }}
        >
          CARGANDO PORTAL SEGURO...
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AssistantProvider userRole="paciente">
      <div className="flex h-screen bg-gray-50 font-sans overflow-hidden relative">
        {menuAbierto && (
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-40 md:hidden transition-opacity"
            onClick={() => setMenuAbierto(false)}
          ></div>
        )}

        <aside
          className={`fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-64 bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out md:relative md:translate-x-0 ${menuAbierto ? "translate-x-0" : "-translate-x-full"}`}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
            <div className="p-6 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 mb-6 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full">
                {/* LOGO DE LA CLÍNICA */}
                <div
                  className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-md text-white font-black shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: colorPrimario }}
                >
                  {nombreClinica.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <h2
                    className="font-black text-gray-900 text-lg tracking-tight truncate"
                    title={nombreClinica}
                  >
                    {nombreClinica}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                    Portal Paciente
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setMenuAbierto(false)}
                className="md:hidden text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-900 shrink-0 ml-2"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-6 h-6"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <nav className="px-4 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
              <Link
                onClick={() => setMenuAbierto(false)}
                href="/dashboard-paciente"
                className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all ${pathname === "/dashboard-paciente" ? "bg-opacity-10 text-opacity-100 shadow-sm" : "text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-gray-900"}`}
                style={
                  pathname === "/dashboard-paciente"
                    ? {

                      }
                    : {}
                }
              >
                🏠 Mi Portal

                style={
                  pathname?.includes("/diario")
                    ? {
                        backgroundColor: `${colorPrimario}15`,
                        color: colorPrimario,
                      }
                    : {}
                }
              >
                📓 Diario Emocional

                        color: colorPrimario,

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { supabase } from "../../../lib/supabase";

export default function DashboardPacientePage() {
  const [nombrePaciente, setNombrePaciente] = useState("Paciente");
  const router = useRouter(); // 🟢 Instanciamos el enrutador para el bot

  useEffect(() => {
    const obtenerUsuario = async () => {
      try {
        const {
          data: { user },
          error: authError,
        } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

        if (authError) throw authError;

        if (user && user.email) {
          // 🟢 MAGIA: Buscamos el nombre real en la base de datos
          const { data: pacienteData, error: dbError } = await supabase
            .from("roles_usuarios")
            .select("nombre")
            .eq("correo", user.email)
            .single();

          if (dbError && dbError.code !== "PGRST116") {
            // Ignoramos el error "no rows returned" por si es nuevo
            console.error("Error al buscar nombre:", dbError);
          }

          // Si hay nombre real, lo usamos. Si no, usamos el truco del correo
          if (pacienteData && pacienteData.nombre) {
            // Mostramos solo el primer nombre para un saludo más amigable
            const primerNombre = pacienteData.nombre.split(" ")[0];
            setNombrePaciente(primerNombre);
          } else {
            const nombrePart = user.email.split("@")[0];
            setNombrePaciente(nombrePart);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error general en el inicio:", error);
      }
    };
    obtenerUsuario();
  }, []);

  // 🤖 RECEPTORES DE EVENTOS DEL ASISTENTE INTELIGENTE
  useEffect(() => {
    // Definimos las acciones que el bot puede ejecutar
    const entrarConsulta = () => router.push("/sala-virtual");
    const configurarPerfil = () => router.push("/dashboard-paciente/perfil");
    const irAHistorial = () => router.push("/dashboard-paciente/historial");

    // Ponemos a la página a escuchar las órdenes exactas
    window.addEventListener("BOT_ENTRAR_CONSULTA", entrarConsulta);
    window.addEventListener("BOT_CONFIGURAR_PERFIL", configurarPerfil);
    window.addEventListener("BOT_IR_HISTORIAL", irAHistorial);

    // Limpieza de seguridad al desmontar el componente
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("BOT_ENTRAR_CONSULTA", entrarConsulta);
      window.removeEventListener("BOT_CONFIGURAR_PERFIL", configurarPerfil);
      window.removeEventListener("BOT_IR_HISTORIAL", irAHistorial);
    };
  }, [router]);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-10 w-full font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-500 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
            Hola, <span className="text-blue-600">{nombrePaciente}</span> 👋
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500 mt-1 font-medium">
            Bienvenido a tu portal de salud mental.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard-paciente/perfil"
            className="bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 font-bold py-2.5 px-5 rounded-xl transition shadow-sm"
          >
            Configurar Perfil
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/sala-virtual"
            className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold py-2.5 px-5 rounded-xl transition shadow-md flex items-center gap-2"
          >

              className="w-5 h-5"

              ></path>

            Entrar a mi Consulta
