                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                  Actualizado:{" "}
                  {new Date(historia.actualizado_en).toLocaleDateString()}
                </span>
                <Link
                  href={`/dashboard-psicologo/historias/${historia.id}`}
                  className="text-indigo-600 text-sm font-bold hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  Abrir Expediente
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {modalAbierto && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[95vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">

              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">
                Apertura de Historia Clínica
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalAbierto(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors bg-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-sm"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

                >
                  <option value="">
                    -- Elige un paciente de tu directorio --
                  </option>
                  {listaPacientes.map((paciente) => (
                    <option key={paciente.id} value={paciente.id}>
                      {paciente.nombres} {paciente.apellidos}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Motivo de Consulta
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={nuevaHistoria.motivo_consulta}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNuevaHistoria({
                      ...nuevaHistoria,
                      motivo_consulta: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all text-slate-700 font-medium resize-none"
                ></textarea>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={guardando || listaPacientes.length === 0}
                  className="w-full md:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center"
                >
                  {guardando
                    ? "Guardando Expediente..."
                    : "Aperturar Historia Clínica"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";

interface Nota {
  id: string;
  titulo: string;
  contenido: string;
  color: string;
  creado_en: string;
}

const COLORES_DISPONIBLES = [
  { id: "bg-yellow-100", clase: "bg-yellow-100", border: "border-yellow-200" },
  { id: "bg-blue-100", clase: "bg-blue-100", border: "border-blue-200" },
  {
    id: "bg-emerald-100",
    clase: "bg-emerald-100",
    border: "border-emerald-200",
  },
  { id: "bg-rose-100", clase: "bg-rose-100", border: "border-rose-200" },
  { id: "bg-purple-100", clase: "bg-purple-100", border: "border-purple-200" },
];

export default function MisNotasPage() {
  const [notas, setNotas] = useState<Nota[]>([]);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);

  const [modalAbierto, setModalAbierto] = useState(false);
  const [guardando, setGuardando] = useState(false);
  const [nuevaNota, setNuevaNota] = useState({
    titulo: "",
    contenido: "",
    color: "bg-yellow-100",
  });

  const cargarNotas = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return;

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("notas_psicologo")
        .select("*")
        .eq("psicologo_id", session.user.id)
        .order("creado_en", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) setNotas(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error cargando notas:", error);
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const inicializar = async () => await cargarNotas();
    inicializar();
  }, [cargarNotas]);

  const guardarNota = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGuardando(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return;

      const { error } = await supabase.from("notas_psicologo").insert([
        {
          psicologo_id: session.user.id,
          titulo: nuevaNota.titulo,
          contenido: nuevaNota.contenido,
          color: nuevaNota.color,
        },
      ]);

      if (error) throw error;

      setNuevaNota({ titulo: "", contenido: "", color: "bg-yellow-100" });
      setModalAbierto(false);
      cargarNotas();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error al guardar:", error);
      alert("Hubo un error al guardar la nota.");
    } finally {
      setGuardando(false);
    }
  };

  const eliminarNota = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm("¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar esta nota?")) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("notas_psicologo")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", id);
      if (error) throw error;
      cargarNotas();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error eliminando:", error);
      alert("Error al eliminar la nota.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto animate-in fade-in duration-500 h-full flex flex-col">
      {/* CABECERA */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center mb-8 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
            Mis Notas Privadas
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
            Apuntes rápidos, hipótesis o recordatorios (no visibles en historias
            clínicas).
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setModalAbierto(true)}
          className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <svg
            className="w-5 h-5"
            fill="none"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"
            />
          </svg>
          Nueva Nota
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* REJILLA DE NOTAS */}
      {cargando ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
        </div>
      ) : notas.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-yellow-50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 shadow-sm">
            <svg
              className="w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
            Tu bloc está vacío
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 max-w-sm">
            Haz clic en &quot;Nueva Nota&quot; para crear tu primer apunte
            rápido.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 items-start">

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Paciente {
  id: string;
  nombres: string;
  apellidos: string;
  nombre_completo?: string; // 🟢 Agregamos esto a la interfaz
  email: string;
  telefono: string;
  identificacion: string;
  creado_el: string;
  fecha_nacimiento: string;
}

export default function PacientesPage() {
  const [pacientes, setPacientes] = useState<Paciente[]>([]);
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [busqueda, setBusqueda] = useState("");

  const [modalAbierto, setModalAbierto] = useState(false);
  const [guardando, setGuardando] = useState(false);
  const [nuevoPaciente, setNuevoPaciente] = useState({
    nombres: "",
    apellidos: "",
    identificacion: "",
    email: "",
    telefono: "",
    fecha_nacimiento: "",
  });

  const cargarPacientes = useCallback(async () => {
    setCargando(true);
    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return;

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("pacientes")
        .select("*")
        .order("apellidos", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) setPacientes(data as Paciente[]);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      let errorReal = "Error desconocido";
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        errorReal = error.message;
      } else if (typeof error === "object" && error !== null) {
        const errObj = error as { message?: string; details?: string };
        errorReal = errObj.message || errObj.details || JSON.stringify(error);
      } else {
        errorReal = String(error);
      }

      console.error("Error REAL cargando pacientes:", error);
      alert(`Error de Base de Datos: ${errorReal}`);
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const inicializar = async () => {
      await cargarPacientes();
    };
    inicializar();
  }, [cargarPacientes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const manejarAperturaModal = () => {
      setModalAbierto(true);
    };

    window.addEventListener("BOT_NUEVO_PACIENTE", manejarAperturaModal);
    return () =>
      window.removeEventListener("BOT_NUEVO_PACIENTE", manejarAperturaModal);
  }, []);

  const guardarPaciente = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGuardando(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return;

      const { data: tu } = await supabase
        .from("tenant_users")
        .select("tenant_id")
        .eq("usuario_id", session.user.id)
        .single();

      if (!tu) throw new Error("No tienes una clínica asignada.");

      // 🟢 CORRECCIÓN: Fusionamos nombre y apellido para enviar el "nombre_completo"
      const nombreCompletoArmado = `${nuevoPaciente.nombres.trim()} ${nuevoPaciente.apellidos.trim()}`;

      const { error } = await supabase.from("pacientes").insert([
        {
          tenant_id: tu.tenant_id,
          psicologo_id: session.user.id,
          nombres: nuevoPaciente.nombres,
          apellidos: nuevoPaciente.apellidos,
          nombre_completo: nombreCompletoArmado, // 🟢 SOLUCIÓN AL ERROR CONSTRAINT
          identificacion: nuevoPaciente.identificacion || null,
          email: nuevoPaciente.email || null,
          telefono: nuevoPaciente.telefono || null,
          fecha_nacimiento: nuevoPaciente.fecha_nacimiento || null,
        },
      ]);

      if (error) throw error;

      setNuevoPaciente({
        nombres: "",
        apellidos: "",
        identificacion: "",
        email: "",
        telefono: "",
        fecha_nacimiento: "",
      });
      setModalAbierto(false);
      cargarPacientes();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      let errorReal = "Error desconocido";
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        errorReal = error.message;
      } else if (typeof error === "object" && error !== null) {
        const errObj = error as { message?: string; details?: string };
        errorReal = errObj.message || errObj.details || JSON.stringify(error);
      } else {
        errorReal = String(error);
      }

      console.error("Error REAL guardando paciente:", error);
      alert(`Error al guardar: ${errorReal}`);
    } finally {
      setGuardando(false);
    }
  };

  const pacientesFiltrados = pacientes.filter((p) =>
    `${p.nombres} ${p.apellidos}`
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(busqueda.toLowerCase()),
  );

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto animate-in fade-in duration-500 h-full flex flex-col">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center mb-8 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
            Directorio de Pacientes
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
            Gestiona los perfiles y datos de contacto de tus clientes.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setModalAbierto(true)}
          className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"
        >
          <svg
            className="w-5 h-5"
            fill="none"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"
            />
          </svg>
          Registrar Paciente
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mb-6 relative">
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-4 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
          <svg
            className="h-5 w-5 text-slate-400"
            fill="none"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            stroke="currentColor"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"
            />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Buscar paciente por nombre o apellido..."
          value={busqueda}
          onChange={(e) => setBusqueda(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all font-medium text-slate-700 shadow-sm"
        />
      </div>

      {cargando ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
        </div>
      ) : pacientesFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center mt-4">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-emerald-50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 shadow-sm">
            <svg
              className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
            No se encontraron pacientes
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 max-w-sm">
            No tienes pacientes registrados aún, o la búsqueda no arrojó
            resultados.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {pacientesFiltrados.map((paciente) => (
            <div
              key={paciente.id}
              className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-4 hover:shadow-md hover:border-indigo-200 transition-all group"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-black uppercase">
                  {paciente.nombres.charAt(0)}
                  {paciente.apellidos.charAt(0)}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                  Activo
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-black text-xl text-slate-900 mb-3 truncate">
                  {paciente.nombres} {paciente.apellidos}
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {paciente.telefono && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600 text-sm font-medium">
                      <svg
                        className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400"
                        fill="none"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        stroke="currentColor"
                      >
                        <path
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                          strokeWidth={2}
                          d="M3 5a2 2 0 012-2h3.28a1 1 0 01.948.684l1.498 4.493a1 1 0 01-.502 1.21l-2.257 1.13a11.042 11.042 0 005.516 5.516l1.13-2.257a1 1 0 011.21-.502l4.493 1.498a1 1 0 01.684.949V19a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1C9.716 21 3 14.284 3 6V5z"
                        />
                      </svg>
                      {paciente.telefono}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {paciente.email && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600 text-sm font-medium">
                      <svg
                        className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400"
                        fill="none"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        stroke="currentColor"
                      >
                        <path
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                          strokeWidth={2}
                          d="M3 8l7.89 5.26a2 2 0 002.22 0L21 8M5 19h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"
                        />
                      </svg>
                      <span className="truncate">{paciente.email}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-4 mt-auto border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                  Ingreso:{" "}
                  {new Date(paciente.creado_el).toLocaleDateString("es-ES", {
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric",
                  })}
                </span>
                <Link
                  href={`/dashboard-psicologo/pacientes/${paciente.id}`}
                  className="text-indigo-600 text-sm font-bold opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-indigo-800"
                >
                  Ver Ficha{" "}
                  <svg
                    className="w-4 h-4"
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {modalAbierto && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 z-10000 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50 shrink-0">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">
                Registrar Paciente
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalAbierto(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors bg-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-sm"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-6 h-6"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={guardarPaciente} className="p-6 space-y-5">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Nombres *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={nuevoPaciente.nombres}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNuevoPaciente({
                        ...nuevoPaciente,
                        nombres: e.target.value,
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all font-medium text-slate-900"
                    placeholder="Ej. Juan Andrés"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Apellidos *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={nuevoPaciente.apellidos}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNuevoPaciente({
                        ...nuevoPaciente,
                        apellidos: e.target.value,
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all font-medium text-slate-900"
                    placeholder="Ej. Pérez Silva"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Cédula / Pasaporte
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={nuevoPaciente.identificacion}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNuevoPaciente({
                      ...nuevoPaciente,
                      identificacion: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all font-medium text-slate-900"
                  placeholder="17xxxxxxxx"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Teléfono
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={nuevoPaciente.telefono}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNuevoPaciente({
                        ...nuevoPaciente,
                        telefono: e.target.value,
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all text-slate-900 font-medium"
                    placeholder="099 999 9999"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Fecha de Nacimiento
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={nuevoPaciente.fecha_nacimiento}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNuevoPaciente({
                        ...nuevoPaciente,
                        fecha_nacimiento: e.target.value,
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all text-slate-900 font-medium"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Correo Electrónico
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={nuevoPaciente.email}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNuevoPaciente({
                      ...nuevoPaciente,
                      email: e.target.value,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all font-medium text-slate-900"
                  placeholder="juan@correo.com"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={guardando}
                  className="w-full px-8 py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center"
                >
                  {guardando ? (
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                  ) : (
                    "Guardar Paciente"
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";

interface PagoHistorial {
  id: string;
  referencia_unica: string;
  monto_esperado: number;
  estado: string;
  fecha_creacion: string;
  comprobante_url: string | null;
  planes?: { nombre: string } | null;
}

export default function HistorialPagosPsicologoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [errorUI, setErrorUI] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pagos, setPagos] = useState<PagoHistorial[]>([]);

  // Estados para el Modal de Reintento
  const [modalRechazo, setModalRechazo] = useState<{
    abierto: boolean;
    pagoId: string;
    referencia: string;
  }>({ abierto: false, pagoId: "", referencia: "" });
  const [archivoNuevo, setArchivoNuevo] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [procesandoArchivo, setProcesandoArchivo] = useState(false);

  const cargarHistorial = useCallback(async () => {
    setCargando(true);
    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) {
        router.push("/login");
        return;
      }

      // 1. Cargar Planes
      const { data: dataPlanes } = await supabase
        .from("planes")
        .select("id, nombre");

      // 2. Cargar Pagos
      const { data: dataPagos, error: errPagos } = await supabase
        .from("pagos")
        .select("*")
        .eq("psicologo_id", session.user.id)
        .eq("entidad_tipo", "suscripcion")
        .order("fecha_creacion", { ascending: false });

      if (errPagos) throw errPagos;

      // 3. Mapear
      if (dataPagos) {
        const pagosDB = dataPagos as unknown as Array<
          PagoHistorial & { entidad_id: string }
        >;
        const pagosEnriquecidos = pagosDB.map((pago) => {
          const planAsociado = dataPlanes?.find(
            (plan) => plan.id === pago.entidad_id,
          );
          return {
            ...pago,
            planes: planAsociado ? { nombre: planAsociado.nombre } : null,
          };
        });
        setPagos(pagosEnriquecidos);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      setErrorUI("No se pudo cargar tu historial de transacciones.");
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, [router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const inicializar = async () => {
      await cargarHistorial();
    };
    inicializar();
  }, [cargarHistorial]);

  // ==========================================
  // REINTENTAR PAGO
  // ==========================================
  const reintentarComprobante = async () => {
    if (!archivoNuevo || !modalRechazo.pagoId) return;
    setProcesandoArchivo(true);
    setErrorUI(null);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("comprobante", archivoNuevo);
      formData.append("pago_id", modalRechazo.pagoId);

      const res = await fetch("/api/suscripciones/comprobante", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${session?.access_token}` },
        body: formData,
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

      setModalRechazo({ abierto: false, pagoId: "", referencia: "" });
      setArchivoNuevo(null);
      await cargarHistorial();

      alert("✅ Comprobante enviado a revisión correctamente.");
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setErrorUI(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "No pudimos procesar el comprobante.",
      );
      setModalRechazo({ abierto: false, pagoId: "", referencia: "" });
    } finally {
      setProcesandoArchivo(false);
    }
  };

  const getEstadoUI = (estado: string) => {
    switch (estado) {
      case "aprobado":
        return (
          <span className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit">
            <svg className="w-3 h-3" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
              <path
                fillRule="evenodd"
                d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z"
                clipRule="evenodd"
              />
            </svg>{" "}
            Aprobado
          </span>
        );
      case "comprobante_recibido":
      case "en_revision":
        return (
          <span className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-amber-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>{" "}
            En Revisión
          </span>
        );
      case "rechazado":
        return (
          <span className="bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit">
            <svg
              className="w-3 h-3"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={3}
                d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
              />
            </svg>{" "}
            Rechazado
          </span>
        );
      case "pendiente_pago":
        return (
          <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest w-fit">
            Incompleto
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest w-fit">
            {estado}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-10 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto animate-in fade-in duration-500">
        {/* ENCABEZADO */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-10 border-b border-slate-200 pb-8">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-2">
              Historial de Facturación
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              Revisa tus pagos de suscripción, su estado de aprobación y
              facturas asociadas.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/dashboard-psicologo/suscripcion"
            className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-sm font-black px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-colors shadow-sm w-fit flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <svg
              className="w-4 h-4"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2.5}
                d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"
              />
            </svg>
            Nueva Suscripción
          </Link>
        </div>

        {errorUI && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-4 rounded-xl font-bold mb-8 border border-red-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3">
            <svg
              className="w-6 h-6 shrink-0"
              fill="none"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              stroke="currentColor"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
              />
            </svg>
            {errorUI}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TABLA PRINCIPAL */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          {cargando ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-slate-800 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
            </div>
          ) : pagos.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-16 text-center">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-50 text-slate-300 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
                <svg
                  className="w-10 h-10"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
                No tienes transacciones
              </h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium max-w-sm mx-auto">
                Aún no has contratado ningún plan de Clinesfera. Ve a Nueva
                Suscripción para empezar.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Detalle del Cargo
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Referencia
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Estado
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-right">
                      Acciones
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {pagos.map((pago) => (
                    <tr
                      key={pago.id}
                      className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors group"
                    >
                      <td className="py-5 px-6">
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base">
                          {pago.planes?.nombre || "Suscripción"}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">
                          {new Date(pago.fecha_creacion).toLocaleDateString()} •{" "}
                          {new Date(pago.fecha_creacion).toLocaleTimeString(
                            [],
                            { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" },
                          )}
                        </p>
                        <span className="font-black text-slate-900">
                          ${Number(pago.monto_esperado).toFixed(2)} USD
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-5 px-6">
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-100">
                          {pago.referencia_unica}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-5 px-6">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                          {getEstadoUI(pago.estado)}
                          {pago.estado === "rechazado" && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-500 max-w-50">
                              Motivo: Comprobante inválido o monto incorrecto.
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-5 px-6 text-right">
                        {pago.estado === "rechazado" && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() =>
                              setModalRechazo({
                                abierto: true,
                                pagoId: pago.id,
                                referencia: pago.referencia_unica,
                              })
                            }
                            className="bg-white border border-rose-200 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 text-xs font-black px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-2"
                          >
                            <svg
                              className="w-4 h-4"
                              fill="none"
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                            >
                              <path
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                strokeWidth={2.5}
                                d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12"
                              />
                            </svg>
                            Corregir Comprobante
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {pago.estado === "aprobado" && (
                          <button className="bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors">
                            Descargar Factura
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {pago.estado === "pendiente_pago" && (
                          <button className="bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs font-black px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors">
                            Completar Pago
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL PARA REINTENTO DE COMPROBANTE */}
      {modalRechazo.abierto && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/80 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 bg-rose-50 flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-rose-900">
                  Solucionar Pago Rechazado
                </h3>
                <p className="text-rose-600/80 text-xs font-bold mt-1 tracking-wider uppercase">
                  Ref: {modalRechazo.referencia}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setModalRechazo({
                    abierto: false,
                    pagoId: "",
                    referencia: "",
                  });
                  setArchivoNuevo(null);
                }}
                className="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors bg-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-sm"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-5 h-5"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2.5}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-8">
              <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm font-medium mb-6">
                Por favor, verifica el monto transferido en tu cuenta bancaria y
                sube el comprobante correcto para enviar nuevamente tu pago a
                revisión administrativa.
              </p>

              <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors rounded-2xl p-6 mb-6 cursor-pointer relative group flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf"
                  className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setArchivoNuevo(e.target.files ? e.target.files[0] : null)
                  }
                />
                <svg
                  className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mb-3 group-hover:text-indigo-500 transition-colors"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M7 16a4 4 0 01-.88-7.903A5 5 0 1115.9 6L16 6a5 5 0 011 9.9M15 13l-3-3m0 0l-3 3m3-3v12"
                  />
                </svg>
                {archivoNuevo ? (
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <p className="font-bold text-indigo-600 line-clamp-1">
                      {archivoNuevo.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                      {(archivoNuevo.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <p className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm">
                      Selecciona el nuevo comprobante
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">PDF, JPG, PNG</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={reintentarComprobante}
                disabled={!archivoNuevo || procesandoArchivo}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-black py-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                {procesandoArchivo ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>{" "}
                    Reenviando...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "Enviar a Revisión"
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../../../lib/supabase";

interface RecaudacionPaciente {
  id: string;
  cita_id: string;
  monto_pagado: number;
  estado_pago: string;
  comprobante_url: string;
  creado_el: string;
  citas?: {
    nombre_paciente: string;
    fecha: string;
    hora_inicio: string;
    modalidad: string;
  } | null;
}

export default function CentroRecaudacionPsicologo() {
  const [cargando, setCargando] = useState(true);
  const [errorGlobal, setErrorGlobal] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [recaudaciones, setRecaudaciones] = useState<RecaudacionPaciente[]>([]);
  const [filtro, setFiltro] = useState<
    "pendientes" | "revision" | "aprobado" | "rechazado"
  >("revision");

  const [procesandoPago, setProcesandoPago] = useState(false);
  const [pagoAConfirmar, setPagoAConfirmar] =
    useState<RecaudacionPaciente | null>(null);
  const [visorComprobante, setVisorComprobante] = useState<{
    url: string;
    titulo: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const cargarPagos = useCallback(async (mostrarLoader: boolean = false) => {
    if (mostrarLoader) setCargando(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
        error: sessionError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      setErrorGlobal(null);

      if (sessionError || !session?.user?.id)
        throw new Error("Error de autenticación.");

      const { data: pagosDB, error: pagosError } = await supabase
        .from("recaudacion_pacientes")
        .select(
          `
          id, cita_id, monto_pagado, estado_pago, comprobante_url, creado_el, psicologo_id,
          citas (nombre_paciente, fecha, hora_inicio, modalidad)
        `,
        )
        .order("creado_el", { ascending: false });

      if (pagosError) {
        throw new Error("No se pudo descargar la información de recaudación.");
      }

      setRecaudaciones((pagosDB || []) as unknown as RecaudacionPaciente[]);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msj =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Error desconocido al procesar la solicitud";
      setErrorGlobal(msj);
    } finally {
      setCargando(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const inicializar = async () => {
      await cargarPagos(false);
    };
    inicializar();
  }, [cargarPagos]);

  const registrarPagoConfirmado = async (accion: "aprobar" | "rechazar") => {
    if (!pagoAConfirmar) return;
    setProcesandoPago(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

      const res = await fetch("/api/recaudacion/procesar", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${session?.access_token}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          recaudacion_id: pagoAConfirmar.id,
          cita_id: pagoAConfirmar.cita_id,
          accion,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error);

      alert(
        `Pago ${accion === "aprobar" ? "registrado y cuenta por cobrar saldada" : "rechazado"} correctamente.`,
      );
      setPagoAConfirmar(null);
      cargarPagos(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msj =
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Error al procesar el pago.";
      alert(`Operación denegada: ${msj}`);
    } finally {
      setProcesandoPago(false);
    }
  };

  const verComprobanteSeguro = async (rutaBucket: string, titulo: string) => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
        .from("comprobantes_pacientes")
        .createSignedUrl(rutaBucket, 60);
      if (error || !data)
        throw new Error("No autorizado para ver este recibo.");
      setVisorComprobante({ url: data.signedUrl, titulo });
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      alert(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Error de seguridad abriendo archivo.",
      );
    }
  };

  const pagosFiltrados = recaudaciones.filter((p) => {
    if (filtro === "pendientes")
      return p.estado_pago === "pending" || p.estado_pago === "pendiente_pago";
    if (filtro === "revision")
      return (
        p.estado_pago === "en_revision" || p.estado_pago === "under_review"
      );
    if (filtro === "aprobado")
      return p.estado_pago === "confirmed" || p.estado_pago === "aprobado";
    if (filtro === "rechazado")
      return p.estado_pago === "rejected" || p.estado_pago === "rechazado";
    return true;
  });

  const getEstadoBadge = (estado: string) => {
    switch (estado) {
      case "confirmed":
      case "aprobado":
        return (
          <span className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-xs uppercase">
            PAGADO
          </span>
        );
      case "en_revision":
      case "under_review":
        return (
          <span className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-xs uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-amber-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>{" "}
            EN REVISIÓN
          </span>
        );
      case "pending":
      case "pendiente_pago":
        return (
          <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-xs uppercase">
            POR PAGAR
          </span>
        );
      case "rejected":
      case "rechazado":
        return (
          <span className="bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-xs uppercase">
            RECHAZADO
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-xs uppercase">
            {estado}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  if (cargando)
    return (
      <div className="p-10 flex justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-10 w-full font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-500 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-20">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-10 border-b border-slate-200 pb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2 tracking-tight">
            Centro de Recaudación
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium text-lg max-w-2xl">
            Gestiona tus cuentas por cobrar, revisa los comprobantes de tus
            pacientes y aplica los pagos recibidos en tu cuenta bancaria.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4 shrink-0 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:pb-0">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center min-w-30 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-700">
              {recaudaciones.filter((p) => p.estado_pago === "pending").length}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">
              Pendientes
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center min-w-30 shadow-sm">
            <p className="text-3xl font-black text-amber-600">
              {
                recaudaciones.filter(
                  (p) =>
                    p.estado_pago === "en_revision" ||
                    p.estado_pago === "under_review",
                ).length
              }
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">
              En Revisión
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center min-w-30">
            <p className="text-3xl font-black text-emerald-600">
              $
              {recaudaciones
                .filter(
                  (p) =>
                    p.estado_pago === "confirmed" ||
                    p.estado_pago === "aprobado",
                )
                .reduce((acc, p) => acc + Number(p.monto_pagado), 0)
                .toFixed(2)}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">
              Recaudado
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {errorGlobal && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-4 rounded-xl font-bold mb-6 border border-red-200 shadow-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
          {errorGlobal}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2 mb-8 bg-white p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm w-full md:w-fit">
        <button
          onClick={() => setFiltro("pendientes")}
          className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-2 ${filtro === "pendientes" ? "bg-slate-800 text-white shadow-md" : "text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Por Pagar{" "}
          <span className="bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs">
            {recaudaciones.filter((p) => p.estado_pago === "pending").length}
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFiltro("revision")}
          className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-2 ${filtro === "revision" ? "bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-md" : "text-slate-500 hover:bg-amber-50 hover:text-amber-600"}`}
        >
          En Revisión{" "}
          <span className="bg-white/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs">
            {
              recaudaciones.filter(
                (p) =>
                  p.estado_pago === "en_revision" ||
                  p.estado_pago === "under_review",
              ).length
            }
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFiltro("aprobado")}
          className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${filtro === "aprobado" ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md" : "text-slate-500 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-600"}`}
        >
          Pagos Confirmados
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFiltro("rechazado")}
          className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${filtro === "rechazado" ? "bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-md" : "text-slate-500 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-700"}`}
        >
          Rechazados
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 min-h-300px">
        {pagosFiltrados.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-16 text-center flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-50 text-slate-300 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                stroke="currentColor"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                  d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">
              Bandeja Vacía
            </h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              No tienes operaciones en esta categoría actualmente.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                  <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Paciente y Cita
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Monto Depositado
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Estado
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-4 px-6 text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-right">
                    Acciones
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {pagosFiltrados.map((pago) => (
                  <tr
                    key={pago.id}
                    className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <td className="py-5 px-6">
                      <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {pago.citas?.nombre_paciente || "Paciente Desconocido"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                        Cita:{" "}
                        {pago.citas
                          ? `${pago.citas.fecha} a las ${pago.citas.hora_inicio?.slice(0, 5)}`
                          : "N/A"}
                      </p>
                      <span className="inline-block mt-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        {pago.citas?.modalidad || "Online"}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-5 px-6">
                      <span className="font-black text-slate-900 text-lg">
                        ${Number(pago.monto_pagado).toFixed(2)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 ml-1">
                        USD
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-5 px-6">
                      {getEstadoBadge(pago.estado_pago)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-5 px-6 text-right space-x-2">
                      {pago.comprobante_url && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            verComprobanteSeguro(
                              pago.comprobante_url,
                              pago.citas?.nombre_paciente || "Recibo",
                            )
                          }
                          className="bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition-colors shadow-sm"
                        >
                          Ver comprobante
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {(pago.estado_pago === "en_revision" ||
                        pago.estado_pago === "under_review") && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setPagoAConfirmar(pago)}
                          className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-black transition-colors shadow-sm"
                        >
                          Aplicar pago
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {pago.estado_pago === "pending" && (
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                          Esperando al paciente
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {pagoAConfirmar && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/70 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 bg-indigo-600 text-white">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black">
                Confirmar aplicación del pago
              </h3>
              <p className="text-indigo-200 text-sm mt-1">
                Procesamiento de cuenta por cobrar del paciente
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 space-y-3 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">Paciente:</span>{" "}
                  <span className="font-black text-slate-900">
                    {pagoAConfirmar.citas?.nombre_paciente}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">
                    Fecha de Cita:
                  </span>{" "}
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {pagoAConfirmar.citas ? pagoAConfirmar.citas.fecha : "N/A"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">
                    Valor depositado:
                  </span>{" "}
                  <span className="font-black text-emerald-600">
                    USD {Number(pagoAConfirmar.monto_pagado).toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-100 flex gap-3 justify-end">
              <button
                onClick={() => setPagoAConfirmar(null)}
                disabled={procesandoPago}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 text-slate-600 font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-xl text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                Cancelar
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => registrarPagoConfirmado("rechazar")}
                disabled={procesandoPago}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-bold hover:bg-rose-200 rounded-xl text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                Rechazar Pago
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => registrarPagoConfirmado("aprobar")}
                disabled={procesandoPago}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black rounded-xl text-sm shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                {procesandoPago ? "Procesando..." : "Aprobar y Confirmar Cita"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {visorComprobante && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/80 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={() => setVisorComprobante(null)}
        >
          <div className="relative max-w-4xl w-full max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col items-center">
            <button className="absolute -top-12 right-0 text-white hover:text-rose-400 font-bold bg-slate-800/50 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors">
              Cerrar Visor ✕
            </button>
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img
              src={visorComprobante.url}
              alt={`Comprobante de ${visorComprobante.titulo}`}
              className="max-w-full max-h-[85vh] object-contain rounded-xl shadow-2xl border-4 border-white"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
